title: Learn Sufi Practices
about: Learn the Sufi path step by step, from the dars of Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. One lesson at a time, at your own pace. Your teacher reviews each lesson and opens the next.
ru_about: Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. ke dars se Sufi raasta qadam ba qadam seekhiye. Ek waqt mein ek sabaq, apni raftaar se. Aap ke ustaad har sabaq dekhte hain aur agla sabaq kholte hain.

lessons.title: What is tasawwuf?

questions.q: According to Hazrat, what is the source of tasawwuf (ilm-e-ladunni)?
questions.ru_q: Hazrat ke mutabiq tasawwuf (ilm-e-ladunni) ka sarchashma kya hai?
ru_options: Deen se bahar koi nayi cheez

questions.q: The body is reformed by Shariat and Tariqat. What reforms the soul?
questions.ru_q: Jism ki islaah Shariat aur Tariqat se hoti hai. Rooh ki islaah kis se hoti hai?

questions.q: Why are there different Sufi ways (Qadri, Chishti, Naqshbandi…)?
questions.ru_q: Mukhtalif silsile (Qadri, Chishti, Naqshbandi…) kyun hain?
options: Only one is right and the others are wrong
They all draw from the Qur'an and Hadith; people's temperaments differ
ru_options: Sirf ek sahi hai, baaqi ghalat
Sab Qur'an aur Hadith se lete hain; logon ke mizaaj alag hain
Har ek ka sarchashma alag hai

lessons.reflect: In your own words: what is tasawwuf, and what does it ask of you?
lessons.ru_reflect: Apne alfaaz mein likhiye: tasawwuf kya hai, aur yeh aap se kya chahta hai?

guide: These practices are effective only under the guidance of a Shaykh. Learn and do them with your Shaykh's permission and supervision.
ru_guide: Yeh amaal sirf Shaykh ki rehnumaai mein hi asar karte hain. Inhein apne Shaykh ki ijaazat aur nigraani mein seekhiye aur kijiye.
